notes.title: Megamagic now for 8’99€ / 9’99$ / 7’99£!
notes.content:
Since last Christmas holidays we’ve had an idea rounding our heads.

Since we are approaching the first year of life of our game “Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age“, we thought it was necessary to facilitate the access to our game to every gamer out there who wanted to enjoy our retro eighties action RPG.

That’s why we’ve decided to make a price drop on our game. You can now grab your copy of Megamagic at Steam for just 8’99€ / 9’99$ / 7’99£.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/19043373/5af163af8077eea3c548414ccdc06227a2a8beea.png

Also, stay tuned because very soon we’ll start unveiling details from our new project and also we have BIG NEWS for Megamagic… but you will have to wait. Don’t worry, it will be worth the wait.

Best,
- BeautiFun Games Team.

notes.title: Best of 2016
notes.content:
It has been a long ride… but thank you 2016!

We started the year with one objective ahead of us: to deliver a game in which we wholeheartedly believe. Our 80s-fueled action RPG “Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age” will be one year old soon (on April 2017) and we want to thank everyone who has played Megamagic or has been interested in our little contribution to the indie game industry.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/19043373/f653a6c2badc6af0b52507b8fa4bcb5db2b518d3.jpg

We’re already working on a new project (which, hopefully, we’ll be able to show you sooner than later!) and as a celebration of what has Megamagic meant to us, here’s some of the Best of 2016 lists in which our game has been featured:

- “10th Best Game of 2016“ by Equilateral.
- “Spanish Indie Games of 2016“ by FSGamer. 
- “Spanish Videogames 2016: Balance of the Year” by Vida Extra.

Looking forward to a promising year 
- BeautiFun Games Team.

notes.title: BeautiFun Games will be at IndieCade 2016
notes.content:
We’ll be attending the Californian festival from  Oct 13th to 16th! 

It’s been a year or so since our last videogame festival abroad, but Festival Season has arrived again for BeautiFun Games. This time, our studio has its next stop in  Los Angeles, California . We are already preparing our long journey to Orange County from the distance (Barcelona!), as you can see:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5177596/73205af2160805afe3bdfc810b74842b9efc58ef.jpg

September has been a busy month for us: we have been preparing our trip and also giving the final touches to  new projects  we are currently working on… and we will be unveil some details sooner than later.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5177596/0cee7f65c8f2966a3b4e28e05a535bd5dfb7960c.jpg

Even though our game “Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age” was not selected in IndieCade 2016’s official selection, we will be attending the whole festival, including the IndieXchange and the GameTasting events. In case you are interested in getting in touch with us or to become acquainted of our games, just send us an email here info@beautifungames.com and let’s meet at IndieCade 2016… or at Hollywood Boulevard!

Have an incredible day,

- BeautiFun Games Team.

notes.title: Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age v1.05 released!
notes.content:
Hi all!
We're bringing you a new update for Megamagic, featuring:
- Windowed mode support (through avanced launcher, holding shift while launching the game).
- Re-balance for some hellish spawners, and some player grims!
- Bug fixing and several game improvements

Enjoy! ːfumː

notes.title: Megamagic v1.02 Update
notes.content:
v1.02 update notes:
- Pool managing improvement, resulting in better performance
- General game tweaking
- General bug fixing

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Megamagic: Wizards of the Neon Age v1.01
notes.content:
Hello!,

It's been two days since we released Megamagic, it was a crazy ride that we've enjoyed so far!. Now we hope you are enjoying our game too!.

Thanks to your feedback we will keep improving it, here are the release notes for the 1.01 version of Megamagic:

- Bug fixing on features and quests.
- Added on hover to in game spells & grims HUD.
- Improved the default resolution detection and not allowed aspect ratios.

Enjoy!

BeautiFun Games Team.
